note: From village field recordings and the Mahantas' classic Bihu records to the yearly Rongali Bihu albums of stars like Zubeen Garg.

size.basis: A 2007 report gives about 100 Bihu cassettes a year plus 30-50 VCDs a season. At roughly 8-10 songs per album over about 40 years of cassette, VCD and online releases, that is some tens of thousands of songs. Add older HMV and radio recordings, and YouTube singles since 2010 that no source counts. The core figure is a guess at the classic Mahanta, Hazarika and Zubeen-era songs every Assamese listener knows.
